inputModel.description: The model, opened by the command line's /i.

params.description: 8bit.task/1: the envelope, with hello.options/1 as its options.

outputModel.description: revit.model/1: the model as the task left it. Optional here; the platform enforces it from result.json.

out_counts.description: 8bit.elementcounts/1: element counts by category, at or above minCount. Optional here; the platform enforces it from result.json.

result.description: 8bit.taskresult/2: what the task did. The one output Design Automation itself requires.

description: HelloBundle count_elements (HelloBundle 1.x): counts the model's elements by category, writes the counts, and stamps the total into project information so the returned model provably differs from the input.
